title: Energy
coreMove: Combine simple direct and indirect moves so the system carries force that no single person has to supply alone.
sourcePressure: The source explains command through subdivisions and signals, direct and indirect methods, inexhaustible combinations, simulated disorder backed by discipline, baits, picked men, and momentum like rolling stones.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Equating energy with hustle, charisma, or personal intensity.

sourceAnchors.name: five musical notes and five primary colours
sourceAnchors.detail: A few elements combine into more melodies and hues than can be exhausted, just as direct and indirect moves combine in battle.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: You do not need many moves; you need a few moves arranged until the combinations multiply.

sourceAnchors.name: the bent crossbow
sourceAnchors.detail: Energy is compared to a bent crossbow and decision to releasing its trigger.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Build the bend before you touch the trigger.

hook: A battlefield metaphor imported into a modern office before the actual choice is visible
A generic sentence about strategy being planning under pressure
counterintuition: The obvious move is not always best; the opposite move is smarter
Winning is not about strength but about strategy
tryThisNow: Set a timer and think about your next battle
Write down your goal and one obstacle

exampleSpecs.domain: orchestra rehearsal preparing a difficult entrance after silence
exampleSpecs.stakes: one mistimed entrance will break the premiere
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: The hall goes still as Megan pairs a visible bow cue with a hidden percussion count so the whole orchestra enters as one body.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a raised bow over a silent stage

exampleSpecs.domain: warehouse pick path redesign before holiday volume
exampleSpecs.stakes: workers are blamed for slowness caused by layout friction
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A yellow tote stalls at the same corner until Daniel changes zones and signals so the flow rolls instead of depending on heroic pickers.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a yellow tote jammed at a conveyor corner

exampleSpecs.domain: theater lighting crew handling a blackout cue
exampleSpecs.audience: stage manager for a touring production
exampleSpecs.stakes: a missed cue leaves actors moving in darkness
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: The blackout is direct; the glow tape is indirect, Manon says, then checks that the hidden guide carries the visible effect.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: glow tape on a stage stair

exampleSpecs.domain: volunteer search team covering a forest grid
exampleSpecs.audience: search coordinator after a missing hiker report
exampleSpecs.stakes: too much individual initiative leaves gaps in the map
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: At 5:18 a.m., Mikkel divides the team by ravine, assigns radio signals, and holds the fastest walkers back for the one place momentum will matter.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: mist caught in a spruce ravine

exampleSpecs.domain: fashion studio launching a capsule collection with scarce fabric
exampleSpecs.audience: production lead in a Milan atelier
exampleSpecs.stakes: one bottleneck cutter could delay every finished piece
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: What happens if the rare fabric waits for the slowest hand instead of the cleanest sequence?
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a bolt of midnight wool on a cutting table

exampleSpecs.domain: airport ground crew turning around a delayed aircraft
exampleSpecs.audience: ramp coordinator at a winter airport
exampleSpecs.stakes: a late departure cascades into missed connections
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: You see Yusuf hold the fuel truck, move baggage first, and use one clear hand signal so separate crews become one release of force.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: orange wands flashing on wet tarmac

skillTargets: identify combined energy rather than individual effort
use direct and indirect moves in sequence
